term: goal realization by an effective means
definition: A valued goal is realized in the supplied one-step efficacy profile when an action is performed and effective for that goal. OnlyEffective identifies an effective action and excludes any other effective action within the action domain. Example: a selected menu action opens the intended dialog; an unrelated selection fails. This is an extensional success relation, not a general metaphysical cause relation, temporal process, or condition on intending, knowing, judging, moral permissibility or rational responsibility. No transitivity, asymmetry or well-foundedness is assumed.
note: A thin extensional means-end profile for the candidate transcendental argument, with no source attribution. The assumption that a goal is in fact realized and that one action alone is effective is explicit. See docs/notes/transcendental-foundation-routes.md.
